body.statement: Under the fixed-nuisance binary-sink restrictions, the structural contractions in \(\texttt{def:fixed-sink-linearization}\) are rational and satisfy \(F_{\eta}(p+u)-F_{\eta}(p)=A_{\eta,t,F}u\) and \(h_{\eta}(p+u)-h_{\eta}(p)=b_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}u\) for every perturbation \(u\) supported on \(J_{t,F}\) with \(p,p+u\in(0,1)^r\). The intercepts are \(c_{\eta}=F_{\eta}(0)\) and \(d_{\eta}=h_{\eta}(0)\).
body.justification: The graph, quotient, and retained forest trace determine the exact observed and interventional linear maps, including their intercepts.
body.gap: Generic polynomial encodings do not isolate this quotient-shared terminal-row affine slice with a trace-supported column set.
body.consumer: The map is the exact rational base case for \(Y_0\)'s negative-certificate checker.
